$comment: Input to scripts/check_release_health.py. One entry per RELEASE LANE:
a tag namespace plus the workflow that is supposed to publish it.
Tag creation here is workflow_dispatch-only by deliberate design, and
that gate exists because 1.13.0 and 1.14.0 were yanked for shipping AGPL
openIMIS benchmark files. Nothing in the release-health lane publishes,
dispatches, or reruns anything: it prints the command a human would run.

lanes.name: PyPI package
lanes.unreleased_remediation: prepare and merge the reviewed version, lock, and changelog update; then run: gh workflow run release.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-flow --ref main -f version=<reviewed-version>
lanes.pypi_remediation: rerun the exact tag-push release.yml run for {tag}; do not create another tag or ref
